What Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Shift+O start; Ask every time lists the block types to choose from. Ctrl+Shift+` always opens a shell block, Ctrl+Shift+A an agent block.
column2: Ctrl+Shift+T、Ctrl+Shift+Enter 和 Ctrl+Shift+O 新建标签页或分屏时启动的程序。「每次询问」会列出可选的区块类型。Ctrl+Shift+` 始终打开 Shell 区块，Ctrl+Shift+A 始终打开智能体区块。

column1: At the edge of a tab

What moving focus further towards a tab's edge does. Next tab goes to the previous or next tab (← and → with tabs along the top, ↑ and ↓ with side tabs) and stops at the first and last; Wrap around loops to the block on the opposite edge.
column2: 焦点已在标签页边缘的区块时，继续朝边缘移动的效果。「下一个标签页」会切换到上一个或下一个标签页（标签在顶部用 ← 和 →，在侧边用 ↑ 和 ↓），到首尾即停；「循环」会绕到另一端的区块。
向左移动焦点时进入文件面板

column1: Moving focus left from a block along the left edge focuses the Files pane while it shows.
column2: 文件面板可见时，从最左侧的区块继续向左移动焦点，就会进入文件面板。

column1: Typing claude, codex or copilot in a new Tern shell opens it in Tern's chat over ACP; the first one asks once. `command claude` runs its own interface.
column2: 在新建的 Tern Shell 中输入 claude、codex 或 copilot 会通过 ACP 在 Tern 内聊天，首次使用时询问一次；使用 command claude 则运行它自己的界面。

column1: How far panes and blocks without focus recede under a wash while a tab is split, so the focused one stands out. Off, every pane keeps its full contrast.
column2: 分屏时调暗没有焦点的窗格和区块，让当前区块更醒目。关闭后每个窗格保持原有对比度。

column1: In Tiles, tabs sit side by side on an endless strip: switching slides the next one in from the side it lies on, past the last tab back to the first. Off, tabs swap at once. Respects Reduce Motion.
column2: 平铺布局中标签页排成一条无尽的长条：切换时下一个标签页从它所在的一侧滑入，越过最后一个会回到第一个。关闭后标签页立即切换。遵循「减少动态效果」设置。

column1: How wide Reader's and Spine's column runs: Standard keeps the conversation to a centered reading column, Wide to a broader one, Full width spreads it across the pane as Console does.
column2: 阅读器和时间线的列宽：「标准」让对话保持在居中的阅读栏，「宽」用更宽的列，「铺满」像控制台一样铺满整个窗格。

column1: How an empty Reader chat opens: a burst of ASCII glyphs, braille printed down the pane or a ripple through the dots, with omp's mark in it until the first prompt. Random picks one each time Tern starts.
column2: 空的阅读器对话打开时播放的效果：ASCII 字符爆散、盲文沿窗格打印，或点阵中泛起涟漪，首个提问前显示 OMP 的标志。「随机」在每次启动 Tern 时选一种。

column1: omp's running subagents and background jobs show as cards over the composer. Off, they show as before the tray: counts of the running agents and jobs over the composer, a click on one opening the agents or the jobs list. Running sessions switch at once.
column2: 将 OMP 正在运行的子智能体和后台任务以卡片显示在输入框上方。关闭后恢复为托盘之前的样子：输入框上方显示运行中的智能体和任务数量，点击其一打开智能体或任务列表。运行中的会话立即切换。

column1: The realtime voice the microphone talks to (on Codex: arbor, breeze, cove, ember, juniper, maple, sol, spruce, vale). Empty uses omp's. Voice needs omp signed in to ChatGPT (Codex), or omp's live.endpoint set to your own realtime server.
column2: 麦克风对话使用的实时语音（Codex 上：arbor、breeze、cove、ember、juniper、maple、sol、spruce、vale）。留空使用 OMP 的设置。语音功能需要在 OMP 中登录 ChatGPT（Codex），或将 OMP 的 live.endpoint 指向自己的实时语音服务器。

column1: Most frames a second Tern draws. Lower uses less power on fast displays; it rounds down to an even share of the display's refresh, so 60 draws 55 on a 165 Hz display.
column2: Tern 每秒绘制的帧数上限。在高速显示器上降低帧率可省电；实际帧率取显示器刷新率的整数分之一，例如 165 Hz 显示器设为 60 帧时实际绘制 55 帧。

column1: Frames wait for the display's refresh. Off shows each one at once: a little sooner, but it may tear. Doesn't change the frame rate.
column2: 等待显示器刷新后再呈现画面。关闭后立即呈现，延迟稍低，但可能出现画面撕裂。不改变帧率。
